name: Will a tub-to-shower conversion increase my home value?
description: A tub-to-shower conversion can increase home value, especially for accessible designs, but consider market appeal if it's your only tub.

mainEntity.name: Will a tub-to-shower conversion increase my home value?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion can positively impact home value, particularly if your home has multiple bathrooms and you are converting the least-used tub into a modern, accessible shower. Many homebuyers prefer the convenience and updated aesthetic of a shower, especially in secondary bathrooms or for aging-in-place considerations. However, if your home only has one bathroom, removing the sole bathtub might deter families with young children, so it's a practical tradeoff to consider your target buyer demographic.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion can increase home value, especially for accessible designs, but consider market appeal if it's your only tub.
